title: svPITE: A Python package for the state-vector-based probabilistic imaginary-time evolution algorithm
summary: We present a Python package for ground-state preparation based on the probabilistic imaginary-time evolution algorithm, with particular focus on its state-vector-based implementation. A standard shot-based simulation is also supported, and results can be benchmarked against exact diagonalisation via a dedicated wrapper. The package enables efficient tuning of initial parameters, facilitating systematic exploration and optimisation of the method's performance.
